# Vantum Intelligence

> The #1 Client Acquisition System for Growing Businesses.

Vantum Intelligence is a business strategy, marketing, and implementation company serving local and regional businesses across Atlanta, Miami, and London. It combines five connected services: strategy and planning (customer research, positioning, and marketing planning), advertising and creative (static and video ad production, campaign management, and creative testing), websites and landing pages (business websites, landing pages, and booking/inquiry forms), search and AI visibility (SEO and AEO work to help search engines and AI tools find and interpret the business), and automation and follow-up (inquiry response, customer follow-up, and CRM workflows). Vantum Intelligence identifies what needs attention and carries out the work directly, rather than handing off strategy to separate vendors.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vantumintelligence.com/): Overview of Vantum Intelligence's strategy, advertising, web, search visibility, and automation services.
- [Services](https://vantumintelligence.com/services): Full breakdown of all five services, with FAQs.
- [Work](https://vantumintelligence.com/work): Selected ad creative and campaign work built for clients.
- [About](https://vantumintelligence.com/about): Vantum Intelligence's background and operating philosophy.
